specs.prompt: Use case: precise-object-edit. Asset type: production sprite, dark fantasy pixel-art trait UI MAX-LEVEL frame. Image 1 is the EDIT TARGET (Normal Legion); image 2 is the approved gold-edged/colored-inner-area STYLE reference ONLY. Preserve the shape and thin proportions of image 1, with its exact upright diamond, four corner ornaments and straight bars. KEEP image 1's simple NORMAL single-rail border with small star/spear corner gems. Do NOT thicken into an ornate special frame. Apply exactly the rule approved in image 2: a thin aged GOLD rim tightly attached to and tracing the outside contour of image 1's colored metal including all corner ornaments, absolutely no gap, no larger detached diamond. Gold #B29A61, small #D6C18B highlights. Main palette: aged muted GREEN metal; interior dark forest/jade green, center #203B2B and edge #102218. The dark tinted interior must be visibly colored, smoothly shaded with subtle pixel texture, quiet and dark enough behind ivory icons. Keep the interior EMPTY; no icon, letter, rune, numeral or patterns. Aged premium gothic mood, restrained saturation, sharp stepped low-resolution pixel-art edges, not glossy 3D. One centered frame on square canvas, fully visible with 6 percent equal margin, symmetric silhouette. Frame layer only. Exterior should be true transparent alpha; if the image encoding cannot provide alpha, use a perfectly uniform chroma magenta #FF00FF exterior for later background removal, NOT a checkerboard. Do NOT paint checkers, captions, labels, scenery, cast shadows, flares or glow. No extra ornaments.
